visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short blonde hair and a black turtleneck sits on a high-speed train, smiling and speaking directly to the camera; the background shows modern train interiors with soft overhead lighting. (2) Close-up of a digital signage screen inside a subway car showing station names like 'Meiji-jingumae', followed by a view of hand straps hanging from the ceiling. (3) The woman is now outdoors on a brick-paved city street, wearing a beige hooded puffer jacket; she pulls the hood tight and crosses her arms, gesturing that it is cold while walking past modern brick buildings. (4) A digital graphic of a spreadsheet titled 'My Treasure List' appears on screen, featuring yellow sparkles and blurred text entries. (5) Wide shot of a shop exterior with a beige noren curtain and the sign 'Nanaya Aoyama' against a red brick building with outdoor wooden chairs. (6) Close-up view of a gelato display case containing various shades of green matcha ice cream and dark sesame flavors. (7) Close-up of hands opening a black gift box to reveal seven gradient shades of green matcha chocolates, followed by a price tag showing 2500 yen. (8) Shots of a menu board for 'AtoZ cafe' followed by printed menus on a table and a view of a strawberry shortcake in a display case. (9) Close-up of a lunch tray featuring two fried croquettes, a bowl of purple grain rice, and small side dishes of pickled vegetables. (10) Back in the cafe, the woman in a gray knit sweater holds a gift bag; the video ends with a screen capture of a Japanese LINE chat message with colorful heart and gift emojis.
